dataset.source: guideline-expert fixture (no source mp4 in workspace; renderer ground truth, confidence=1)

hypotheses.observed: Expert Hold appears in 13 placements; frozen Beam never holds.
hypotheses.cause: Hold search is default-off because equal-weight Hold over-held and lost lines.
hypotheses.improvement: Keep Hold off as an equal candidate. Add a gated Hold: only when current is I and no tetris, or hold is I and a well is ready.
hypotheses.benchmark: A/B Hold-gated vs frozen hold-off on the same seeds; require lines not to regress.

hypotheses.observed: Expert moves sit in Beam's list but below top-10 — the search sees them, the eval ranks them away.
hypotheses.cause: Leaf eval is almost the same board heuristic as 2-ply; depth 3 cannot invent setup value that the leaf does not score.
hypotheses.improvement: Put setup features in the leaf (well, T-slot, I-hold), not more depth.
hypotheses.effect: Depth 3 starts preferring the same setups the expert keeps.
hypotheses.benchmark: Human/expert rank of well-preserving moves should rise; frozen 3×12 A/B.

hypotheses.observed: Expert preserves a 1-wide well in 16% of disagreements.
hypotheses.cause: Current evaluator treats wells as a penalty and linesCleared as a large bonus, so Beam fills the well for a single.
hypotheses.improvement: Add a tetris-well feature (deep 1-wide column next to high walls) and a penalty for filling it with a non-I piece.
hypotheses.effect: Fewer well-kills, more 4-line clears later; Hold-I becomes useful instead of harmful.
hypotheses.benchmark: Same 5×40 and 10×100 seeds vs frozen Beam 3×12. Watch tetrises, lines, and well-fill rate.

hypotheses.observed: Expert surfaces are flatter / less holed than Beam's choice on disagreements.
hypotheses.cause: bumpiness is adjacent-column only; overhangs and 2-wide trenches are weak.
hypotheses.improvement: Add overhang / covered-hole and 2-wide trench features.
hypotheses.benchmark: holes and bumpiness after 40 pieces vs frozen.

hypotheses.observed: Expert continues a combo when Beam drops a no-clear placement.
hypotheses.cause: combo weight is small and only applied after the fact.
hypotheses.improvement: Add a next-clear-likelihood term when combo >= 1 (almost-full rows).
hypotheses.effect: Short REN chains in downstack, not endless combo hunting.
hypotheses.benchmark: maxCombo and lines; reject if holes explode.

hypotheses.observed: A slice of disagreements has no clean mechanic label.
hypotheses.improvement: Keep them unlabeled; do not fit weights to them.
hypotheses.benchmark: Manual review sample, not an automatic win.
